test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘NOVEL’ is written as ‘SSYGM’, and ‘MUSIC’ is written as ‘RYVKD’. How will ‘ORDER’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘NOVEL’ is written as ‘SSYGM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34336c3c68aacefb068088bc8c4a28387546f152518fe67907888d81b5a8589f.png] 

‘MUSIC’ is written as ‘RYVKD’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b8c51a5e6bc10bd19fbfbed2fce61d057cc0a75d109d01cddffbbeb41cb0d35.png] 

Similarly, ‘ORDER’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e937f9453c403d4bd294116e9bcfded5df48817eb84ec5bff562d4d1a75edef.png] 

Hence,** 'option 1' **is the correct answer.
